record.perfect_high_volume.evidence: tools/test-events.js: 10-for-10 vs 9-for-9; seen in full-season run

record.minutes_sixth_overtime.data: franchise minutes record kept within the save
record.minutes_sixth_overtime.evidence: detection path; 6-overtime games are vanishingly rare in the sim
record.minutes_sixth_overtime.note: Franchise minute records start with the save (real franchise records are not in the dataset).

record.career_free_throw_mark.note: Needs each real player's career-to-date totals at the save's start season (build-history.py exports only full-career totals).

record.oldest_debut.note: Needs a debut-age record table and first-appearance tracking for generated/draft players.

record.one_point_scoring_record.note: Needs season FTM record book; box data exists.

record.shared_jersey_milestone.note: Needs career milestone tracking (career totals per player in the save).

court.four_point_play.data: made three + shooting foul + made free throw

court.charge_triple.handler: gamesim offensive fouls (charges drawn per defender) -> HL.Events.fromGame

court.no_field_goals_quarter.evidence: test-events.js; does not occur in normal play (as in reality)

court.self_rebound_putback.handler: gamesim marks putbacks (offensive rebounder scoring next)
court.self_rebound_putback.note: Recorded on decisive shots only (as part of game-winner events); not published as its own story because it happens many times a game.

court.shot_clock_buzzer_make.note: Needs a per-possession shot-clock model; the sim uses possession durations, and only period-ending shots are timed.

court.buzzer_review_reversal.note: Needs an officiating/replay layer in the game sim.

court.backcourt_violation_decider.note: Needs turnover types (violations) in the sim.

court.heave_team_record.note: Heaves exist; shot distance is not modeled, so no distance record yet.
